name: sundry-icon-set-cplus-drop-b

rules.microRule: Use svg/micro at 14px where supplied; otherwise svg/base.

semanticNotes.compose: Keyboard/form metaphor so it cannot be confused with Drop A edit/pencil.
semanticNotes.receipt-scan: Receipt plus scan frame for the camera path.
semanticNotes.receipt-view: Receipt plus eye, distinct from scan.
semanticNotes.sign-out: Door plus outward arrow; designed to read without a label.
semanticNotes.retry: Circular retry, distinct from Drop A undo.
semanticNotes.calendar-week: Seven-day pattern, distinct from Drop A calendar/date-range.

briefConsistencyNote: The brief says two icons are marked [micro], but only external-link is explicitly marked 14px/[micro]. No unmarked second micro icon was guessed.
